item.title: Appulse - pinball/shooter/roguelite (nextfest demo out!)
item.author: invalid@example.com (Shiki)
item.dc:creator: Shiki
item.content:encoded: Discovered that little gem a few days ago and been completely hooked by the gameplay. It's essentially a pinball game on a spaceship where the ball is equipped with guns you can control. While you have limited ammo, hitting the ball with a flipper reloads it and weapons have varying amounts of recoil you can use to modify your trajectory so guns are useful even outside attacking enemies.
